acceptance_criteria.text: Shared parser accepts max/ultra and rejects unknown values.
CLI, gateway session/global, TUI, and command registry expose max/ultra.
All gateway locale guidance advertises max/ultra.
Codex main and auxiliary transports map configured ultra to wire max.
Ultra adds proactive delegation guidance at request time only for openai-codex with delegate_task; persisted prompts and non-Codex fallbacks stay clean.
Live Codex protocol and native client semantics are proven.
No global default switch or gateway restart occurs before verification.
Durable upstream precedence guard exists and detects future native support.
Targeted tests, lint, compile, diff, and security checks pass.
Reviewed feature is committed, pushed, merged into live runtime branch, restarted externally, and smoke-tested.
